# hpe_morpheus_network_pool (Data Source)



## Example Usage

### Look up by ID

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_network_pool" "example" {
  id = 99
}
```

### Look up by Name

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_network_pool" "example" {
  name = "Morpheus"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the network pool
- `name` (String) The name of the network pool

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) The display name of the network pool
- `free_count` (Number) Available IPs in pool
- `gateway` (String) Gateway address
- `ip_count` (Number) Total IPs in pool
- `netmask` (String) Subnet mask
- `pool_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the pool is enabled
- `subnet_address` (String) Subnet address
- `type_code` (String) The pool type code
